description: The line plot illustrates the memory consumption (in GB) as a function of the number of video frames processed by five different video understanding models: VideoLLaMB, VideoLLaMB-R, LLaVA-NeXT, VideoLLAVA, and an unlabeled green line with circle markers (possibly a variant or baseline). The x-axis, labeled “Number of Frames,” spans from 0 to 1000 in linear increments of 200. The y-axis, labeled “Memory (GB),” ranges from 0 to 400 in linear increments of 50. VideoLLaVA (purple line with circle markers) exhibits the steepest memory growth, starting near 15 GB at 0 frames and rising sharply to over 400 GB by 300 frames. LLaVA-NeXT (cyan line with circle markers) shows a steady linear increase from approximately 10 GB at 0 frames to 145 GB at 1000 frames. The green line with circle markers increases from about 15 GB to 75 GB over the same range. VideoLLaMB-R (brown line with circle markers) remains relatively flat, rising from ~15 GB to ~35 GB. VideoLLaMB (red line with circle markers) is not visibly plotted, suggesting either negligible memory usage or missing data points in the displayed range.
